paper_title: A New Bound on Axion-Like Particles
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper presents a new upper bound on axion-photon coupling g_agamma from Chandra X-ray observations of M87 nucleus in the Virgo cluster. The primary conservative limit is g_agamma < 2.6×10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for ALP masses m_a ≤ 10^-13 eV (equation 1.3, B0=35 µG). A stronger limit of g_agamma < 1.49×10^-12 GeV^-1 is obtained with benchmark magnetic field parameters (B0=31.5 µG, equation 5.3). The bound is mass-independent (flat) for m_a < 3×10^-12 eV, so encoded as a horizontal line from 1e-13 eV to 1e-11 eV at the conservative coupling value. This is an astrophysical constraint from absence of spectral distortions due to ALP-photon conversion in the cluster magnetic field, not a haloscope experiment, so no local DM density is applicable.
